name: Danny

appearance.markings: Orange spots across his body and tail
appearance.spikes: Bright orange rounded spikes running along his head and back
appearance.face: Rounded friendly snout with a warm smile
appearance.arms: Short arms with small rounded claws
appearance.tail: Long curved tail with orange markings and spikes

consistency_rules: Always maintain the same teal body colour
Always retain the orange spots and orange spikes
Keep the same head and body proportions
Keep the large expressive brown eyes
Never change Danny's fundamental appearance between scenes
